label: Quick Actions
title: From a prompt to a running agent.
description: Press Shift twice, type what you want and hit Enter. A new Claude Session starts in the Project, shows up in the sidebar and gets to work.

label: Changes
title: Turn review notes into the next change.
description: Open a Task's diff, leave notes on the lines you want changed and send them all to the running agent in one go. It applies them in its own terminal, next to the sidebar.

label: Ask To
title: Get a second opinion without copy-paste.
description: Just ask in the prompt: "Can you ask another Claude agent to review this?" A helper Session appears under the agent, and its review comes back to the agent that asked.

label: Tasks
title: Define the work. Add a worktree when needed.
description: Keep the goal, acceptance criteria and checklist in one Task. When the change needs its own checkout, create a branch and worktree from that same Task.

label: Handoff
title: Move context to the agent already in the work.
description: Send a visible, composed handoff from one running Project Session to another. The target receives the brief in its own real terminal and continues from there.

label: Session Fork
title: Explore another direction in a real terminal.
description: Fork a Session from the sidebar, see the parent-child relationship, and continue in a new Ghostty terminal. The branch in thinking is explicit instead of becoming another anonymous tab.

label: Code review
title: Review changes where they happened.
description: Read the diff, compare versions side by side and keep track of the files you have checked.
